name: matched-ks3-all-width768-normlr
hypothesis: Reduce both dense and routed KS3 projection widths from1024 to768 at rank1 to test a different capacity/elapsed-time tradeoff. Set the KS3 projection multiplier to sqrt(1024/768), preserving the original effective ANVIL multiplier after its shape factor falls to1. Retain zero geometry coefficients, geometry Adam0.125, BF16/GS32, MoE8top1 and all shared/model-wide settings. Require CPU architecture and optimizer audits plus the independent width768 output/gradient oracle and actual graph warmup before the nominal900s discovery.
